description: <attemptDir>/cancel-requested.json. Published once by anyone allowed to cancel the attempt (Ctrl-C in the controller, recover). The supervisor polls for it and reads only attemptId; it then publishes stop-requested {cause: cancel} and SIGTERMs the gate. `by` and `requester` say who asked and are for the unit-state view and the audit trail, never for the supervisor's decision.

fields.requestedBy: required, string, free text label for a person reading the file (e.g. controller pid or user)

by.note: required; `recover` is reserved for a recover action that cancels a live attempt; no such action exists yet

fields.requester: processTuple (supervisor-binding.v1.json) of the process that wrote the file
fields.at: string, ISO-8601 UTC, when the request was made
